Global options such as `--base-url`, `--tenant` and `--json` go before the command — see [CLI reference](./index.mdx#global-options). Exit codes are listed in [Exit codes](./exit-codes.md).

## apiome logout {#logout}

Revoke the key `apiome login` saved and remove it from the config file.

A key you saved yourself is kept; remove it with `apiome config unset api-key`.

```text
apiome logout [OPTIONS]
```
